Done. I've added the $500+ tier (20% discount) and implemented the member bonus logic. Members get 5 percentage points on top of their tier, capped at 22% total.

The existing tiers behave identically—only orders with subtotals less than 500 are affected by the member bonus:
- Under $100: 0% → 5% for members
- $100–$249: 5% → 10% for members
- $250–$499: 10% → 15% for members
- $500+: 20% → 22% for members (capped)
